ask.title: Ask the base
ask.about: A question in your own words. The engine assembles context from the cards, the model answers from them only and cites every statement. Cards are not edited — but the conversation is saved into the project base (meta/ask/) and goes to git with it: what the team asked and what the base answered is visible to everyone.
ask.placeholder: For example: what happens to the guarantee if the document is cancelled before import?
ask.placeholder_thread: A follow-up question — the model remembers what the conversation is about
ask.ring: by the ring (primary, the spare on refusal)
ask.export_hint: Export the questions and answers of this conversation into an .md file
ask.ping_hint: A live request to the primary model: is it answering right now
ask.primary_hint: Clear the «not answering» mark and return to the primary model
ask.history_about: Shared by the whole team: conversations live in the base and arrive with a sync. Open a conversation to read it in full and ask a follow-up — the model will see what it is about.
ask.asking: assembling context and asking the model…
ask.asking_thread: rereading the conversation, assembling context and asking the model…
ask.spare_toast: The spare model answered — the primary is not responding. Use «Back to the primary» once it is up
ask.thread_before: The next question goes into the conversation
ask.thread_after: — the model will see the earlier questions and answers.
ask.export_empty: Nothing to export — there is no answer yet
ask.md_thread: - Conversation in the base: `AuroraKnowledgeDB/meta/ask/{id}.md` — make edits there, this file is a copy
ask.models_failed: models are not loaded: {why} — open the section again
ask.models_empty: the agent settings have no models — set them in «Project settings»
ask.primary_note: The primary model will be checked on the next question
ask.history_pick_project: Pick a project on the Bridge.
ask.history_failed: The history could not be read: {why}. Open the section again; if it repeats, restart the panel.
ask.history_empty: No conversations yet. The first one appears after a question — and reaches everyone who syncs the base.
